create.title: Create blood request
create.subtitle: Requests are reviewed by a coordinator before they appear publicly. Only include what responders need.
create.coordinationSubtitle: Tell responders where to go and how to reach the right desk — never a private number.
create.reviewSubtitle: Check the public version carefully. A coordinator will review it before it’s published.
create.notEditable: This request can’t be edited any more.
create.notEditableBody: Only drafts and requests sent back for correction can be edited here.
create.draftSavedBody: {{id}} is saved in Drafts. It isn’t public.
create.saveFailedBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was lost on this page.

fields.unitsHelp: Enter only if confirmed by the facility.
fields.neededByHelp: Shown publicly as a date only.
fields.municipalityHelp: We never ask for a street or home address.
fields.summaryHelp: Don’t include patient names, diagnoses, room numbers or personal phone numbers.
fields.pointHelp: Missing a point? An administrator must approve new coordination points.
fields.visibility: Who can see the contact details
fields.visibilityHelp: Applies to the desk phone or email only.
fields.instructionsHelp: Shown publicly. Avoid personal names and numbers.
fields.instructionsPlaceholder: Visit the blood services desk during desk hours and mention the request ID.

contactMethod.desk_phone: Facility desk phone (from the approved coordination point)
contactMethod.none: No direct contact — responders visit during desk hours

errors.neededBy: Choose the date the blood is needed by.
errors.pastDate: Date can’t be in the past.
errors.units: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
errors.window: Enter both times, with the desk closing after it opens.
errors.confirm: Confirm the details before you submit.

warning: BloodMap does not assess medical need or donor eligibility. Describe the request, not the patient.

pointPanel.title: Coordination point
pointPanel.body: Responders are always directed to an authorized facility or desk.
pointPanel.noPoint: Your account isn’t linked to an approved coordination point yet. An administrator must approve one before you can submit.

preview.heading: What the public will see
preview.noSummary: Your short public description will appear here.
preview.account: Your name and account — never public

checks.address: No street address or exact coordinates
checks.personal: No patient name or diagnosis detected in the description
checks.personalFlagged: Possible personal details in the description or instructions — check before submitting
checks.desk: Contact limited to an approved desk

review.confirm: I confirm these details were confirmed with the facility and contain no personal information about the patient.
review.roleNote: Your role (Facility submitter) can submit for review. Coordinators see “Publish” here instead — the server decides which action is allowed.

submitted.title: Request submitted
submitted.body: Thanks — your request is in the review queue. It isn’t public yet. You’ll get an email when a coordinator approves it or asks for a correction.

steps.reviewMeta: Usually within a few hours during desk hours
steps.published: Published on the map — or sent back with a note
steps.expiresMeta: {{when}}, unless you extend or close it
steps.expiresUnknown: When the desk window closes on the needed-by date, unless you extend or close it

mine.title: My requests
mine.subtitle: Everything submitted from {{desk}}.
mine.draftsSubtitle: Requests you started but haven’t submitted. Drafts are never public.
mine.caption: My requests

empty.title: No requests yet
empty.body: Requests you create appear here, from draft to closed.
empty.filteredBody: Try another status, blood type or date.
empty.draftsBody: Drafts you save while creating a request appear here.

actions.editLocked: Active requests can’t be edited. Ask a coordinator or close and resubmit.
actions.fulfilledBody: {{id}} is off the public map and list.
actions.closedBody: {{id}} is off the public map and list.
actions.failedBody: It may have changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
actions.closeBody: It will disappear from the public map and list immediately. Donors who saved it will see it as Closed. This can’t be undone — you’d need to submit a new request.
actions.closeReasonHelp: Kept in the request history. Not shown publicly.
actions.closeReasonRequired: Add a short reason (at least 3 characters).

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another account.
detail.notYet: Set when a coordinator publishes it
detail.correction: A coordinator asked for a correction

history.approvedNote: Submitted details confirmed — not a medical verification.
